
Notes on how to build custom DESI environment using conda

Followed the instructions given here: https://desi.lbl.gov/trac/wiki/Pipeline/GettingStarted/NERSC

for adding future packages
activate conda with 
	mydesienv
install your desired package
	pip3 install <package name>
add to package list under ~/conda/<package list name>

for pycorr specifically
	export USE_GPU = 0
	python -m pip install git+https://github.com/cosmodesi/pycorr#egg=pycorr[corrfunc]
